purpose: Pre-registered evaluator and geometry-audit contract; not a model-selection or threshold-tuning configuration.
hd95_definition: 95th percentile of concatenated bidirectional foreground surface distances in native physical spacing
nsd_definition: fraction of concatenated bidirectional foreground surface distances <= nsd_tolerance_mm in native physical spacing
lesion_match_rule: one-to-one maximum-overlap assignment; a matched pair counts as TP only when voxel overlap is > 0
prediction_input_contract: Metrics accept binary masks only. Probability maps must be finite, lie in [0,1], and be explicitly thresholded before evaluation; logits are never accepted as probabilities.
r1_probability_threshold_role: fixed validation fixture only; not tuned in R1 and not a candidate-selection decision
